mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, b.name AS brand_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id
mapper.select: WHERE p.brand_id = #{brandId} ORDER BY p.id DESC
WHERE b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{brandName}, '%') ORDER BY p.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product(name, brand_id, price, stock, description, image) VALUES (#{name}, #{brandId}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{description}, #{image})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = #{stock} WHERE id = #{id}
